title: Shadow Sword
answer: The Shadow Sword routes every unlocked innate and crystal invocation through a corrupted presentation. It has exactly three rites of its own: Call the Hollowed summons Darkness creatures; Blight Ground infects nearby terrain; Nightfall Dominion is a rank-ten apotheosis. Its eight-slot wheel is persistent. Shift-use opens the wheel, Shift-scroll cycles favourites, and use casts the selected invocation. At Darkness rank ten, sword cooldowns are removed; bounded server work budgets still apply.
